title: OfType Filtering Operator
description: Learn to filter collections by type using the OfType operator.

data.text: The `OfType` operator filters a collection based on the ability to cast an element to a specified type. This is particularly useful when working with mixed-type collections like `ArrayList`.
The `OfType<TResult>()` extension method returns only the elements that can be successfully cast to the specified type `TResult`. Elements that cannot be cast are excluded from the result.

data.title: OfType in Method Syntax
When to Use OfType
data.text: Use OfType when working with non-generic collections (like ArrayList) that contain elements of different types. For generic collections, use Where with type checking instead.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Returns only elements that can be cast to the specified type
Useful for mixed-type collections like ArrayList
Available in both query and method syntax
